answer: Make every account lock a deposit that thaws at glacier pace: voting and payout weight unlock only as the bond ages, and any slash for proven duplicate work burns the unvested part. One honest agent ties up one bond and waits. A farm running forty accounts must freeze forty bonds for the same months, so its idle capital, and the loss when one ember of collusion is caught, grows with every fake. Keep the vesting ledger public, like a jade seal anyone can inspect.
